title: Chapter 144 Flying Snow Jade Flower
content:
Chapter 144 Flying Snow Jade Flower

Walking slowly, he walked through the dark corridor and came to the brightly lit hall.

In the hall, there is a pool of water, which is full of golden lotus. There is also a glorious jade platform in the center of the pool, with a little decoration, it is a good place for dancing.

Walking to both sides from the entrance of the corridor, he found a separate private room, and sat down with Zhao Yun and others.

At this moment, tonight's dance has not yet started, but many guests have already arrived, and the noise filled the entire hall.

"Brother Liu, are you here too?"

"Oh, brother Huang, I didn't expect you to come here too. Did you also hear that the oiran here came here to learn your girl's peerless dance?"

"That's right, that's right, Brother Liu, please sit down with me quickly!"

"Okay, then you're welcome, brother!"

Beside, there are two familiar men in a position, talking.

When I came to the private room, I waited for the table, ordered a few small dishes, and served the unique spirits of Yan Kingdom, and waited here for Xue Nu's performance.

After a while, about an hour or so.

After waiting for a long time, all the customers who wanted to watch the show had arrived, the whole hall was crowded with people, and all the seats were occupied, but there were still many people who would rather stand and see the Snow Maiden here. world dance.

With the sound of a melodious piano, the originally noisy and noisy hall suddenly became colder. Everyone was calm and focused, holding their breath, and looked closely at the center of the hall. The Sanzhang Yutai in the palace.

On the jade platform, there was a slight movement slowly.

On the side of the jade platform, sparks were suddenly lit up, three circles inside and outside, and the candles that illuminated the entire half of the jade platform were brightly lit.

The secluded pool next to the Sanzhang Yutai originally sank at the bottom of the pool, and the hard-to-see golden lotus also slowly emerged, holding up rippling ripples.

With the appearance of the golden lotus, the sound of the zither became more intense, followed by bursts of chiming bells.

Following the sound of the zither bell, a Yiren suddenly appeared on the jade platform. It's just that the figure is covered by the red curtain, so I can't see clearly, but the figure that comes out faintly can be seen as a stunning beauty.

Immediately, from the direction of this stunning Yiren, bursts of ear-piercing Xiao sounds, together with the sound of the surrounding piano bells, played a peerless melody of nature.

After half a ring, Xiao Yin fell, and the sound of the zither bell stopped.

The red curtain quickly hovered upwards, gradually revealing the appearance of this peerless Iraqi. As the cover slowly disappeared, in the twilight, this stunning beauty began her alluring dance.

After making a few movements, the surrounding guests opened their mouths wide in surprise, and the wine glasses that were clenched in their hands fell from their hands, but none of them noticed.

The dance didn't stop because of these few details, on the contrary, it was faster and completed in one go. Xue Nu continued to show everyone her perfect figure and dancing posture that was almost Tao.

It was snowing heavily outside Feixue Pavilion, the north wind howled, and heavy snow fell continuously.

At the top of the hall, snowflakes are constantly floating on the open-air terrace, accompanied by the dancing posture of the snow girl, moving with the wind.

Unknowingly, time passed slowly.

A peerless dance, with the flow of time, passed slowly.

"Crack, clap, clap!"

A burst of annoying applause resounded in the corridor outside the hall, which woke up the guests who were intoxicated in this charming dance, and caused bursts of dissatisfaction.

Among them were Zhong Yu and the others.

Xue Nu got up and turned around calmly.

There are two guests in the corner, "Who are you, so presumptuous!"

"It's here to stir things up."

However, these human rights are relatively humble and dare not speak loudly. Others are different.

Yan Yi, the general of the Yan Kingdom, asked angrily: "Huh! What bastard, disturb the general's elegant mood, get out of here."

As soon as Yan Yi's voice fell, his two servants in the corridor said in a panic:

"Oops, my lord drank too much again."

"Oh, what a tragedy!"

"What's wrong?"

"Looking at the many royal guards on the street just now, I knew that a big man from the royal family was coming, but I still didn't expect it to be, it was this one!"

"Who is this lord?"

"He is the most powerful person in our country of Yan, the uncle of the great king, and the life and death of everyone in the country of Yan is in his hands!"

Afterwards, there was another classic dialogue in the original anime, Yanchun Jun was among this group of wealthy businessmen and dignitaries from all over the world. Once again, he pretended to be a coward, showing off his power as the most powerful person in Yan Kingdom, except King Yan.

Then, with some witty dialogue, Xue Nu made Yan Chunjun give up the idea of killing without the slightest fear.

However, she also fell into a difficult situation.

"Must see blood? Hahaha... Interesting. Never dance this dance in front of people, but it's not difficult. It's elegant and suitable in the palace, and it's rare for strangers. Since Miss Xuenv can't make Lingbo Feiyan public, then in My mansion should be the most suitable place, I wonder if Miss Xue Nu will show you her favor?" I was rejected many times just now, but Mr. Yanchun is not upset, the beauty in front of me is definitely worth asking for many times.

There was a little noble next to him, who saw Jun Yanchun's movements, and sighed, "Jun Yanchun is going to be tough, this is not good for Xuenv! Although Xuenv speaks cleverly, but Jun Yanchun is not an ordinary nobleman."

"Come here! Please Miss Xuenv go back to the house." Seeing that Xuenv was speechless and seemed to be stumped by himself, Jun Yanchun said directly

Lord Yanchun's personal guards came to Xuenv after hearing the order: "Please! Please! Please give me the honor, Miss Xuenv, please show me the light, Miss Xuenv! Please—"

Gao Jianli, who was behind the mat, saw his beloved woman being forced by the fat-headed Yan Chunjun in front of him, and was about to get up.

But before he started to move, he was interrupted by a burst of laughter.

"Hehehe...hehe...hehe!" A long-lasting laughter resounded in the hall, shocking everyone.

"Who? Dare to be presumptuous here?" one of Yanchun Jun's guards shouted loudly.

The people around also changed their colors one after another. They followed the voice and wanted to see who this daring person was.

The direction of the voice was on the second floor above this hall. There were more than ten people sitting there, headed by a man in purple robe, and this was the one who just laughed.

Yanchun Jun squinted his eyes, and looked at the man through the gauze curtain he set up.

"Interesting, really interesting! Everyone here, even the general of the Yan Kingdom, is like a dog in front of me, begging for mercy. How dare you stand up at this time, is there something to rely on, or is it a moment of bloody courage?" Lord Yanchun's voice was sinister, but he could see that the person in front of him must be of extraordinary status, but he didn't seem like a person from Yan Kingdom, so he made a sound to test.
